subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: What permanent contract should external config-write callers receive for comment-loss diagnostics?
rationale: ConfigWriteResult and ConfigReplaceResult are exposed through the plugin SDK, so choosing a one-off string, a typed diagnostics collection, or no public result field is an API-direction decision rather than a routine implementation detail.

options.title: Use typed diagnostics
options.body: Replace the one-off warning string with an extensible typed diagnostics collection carrying a stable code, affected path, and message.

options.title: Approve the optional string
options.body: Keep warning?: string as the additive plugin SDK contract and document that callers may surface or serialize it.

options.title: Keep it CLI-internal
options.body: Remove the result-type additions and surface comment loss only through owner-specific CLI or logger handling that respects quiet mode.

recommendation.title: Use typed diagnostics
recommendation.body: Replace the one-off warning string with an extensible typed diagnostics collection carrying a stable code, affected path, and message.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history spans the config-write orchestration and public runtime boundaries affected by this contract choice.
